goal: Den naechsten sicheren Masken-Baukasten-Slice als rein temporaere, browserinterne Beschriftungsbearbeitung planen. Schritt 1 soll genau die Beschriftung eines bestehenden Draft-Elements per keyboard-first Editierweg aendern, bei stabiler Draft-ID, kind, column und width. Schritt 2 darf erst nach gruenem Zwischen-Gate leere/Whitespace-Eingaben, Escape-Abbruch, deterministische Fokus-Rueckgabe und schmale/200-Prozent-Bedienbarkeit haerten. Keine Persistenz, kein allgemeiner Eigenschaften-Editor und kein Drag-and-Drop.

guide_delta.summary: I104 bleibt nach I105 unveraendert im Produktscope: ausschliesslich die Beschriftung eines bestehenden temporaeren Elements soll bearbeitet werden. I105 aenderte nur Dokumentation/Governance; Browser-Shell und gezielte Tests sind unveraendert.

direct_dependencies: I105 product roadmap/governance merged; documentation/governance only, no browser-shell or test-path changes
Step 2 is blocked until Step 1 implementation and targeted UI gate are green
tests_required: Step 1: targeted browser-shell compile and regression tests
Step 1: existing draft exposes a keyboard-reachable Beschriftung-aendern control
Step 1: valid label edit changes only item.label
Step 1: draft ID, kind, column and width remain unchanged
Step 1: preview updates deterministically after label edit
Intermediate gate: Step 2 starts only when Step 1 is green
Step 2: empty or whitespace-only label is rejected before mutation
Step 2: Escape cancels without mutation and restores focus deterministically
Step 2: narrow/200-percent-equivalent layout keeps edit controls reachable without horizontal overflow
GET-only and loopback-only contracts remain unchanged
no persistence, network-write, database or store dependency
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because this plan is isolated to the browser mask-builder shell
database regressions because no database path changes
template-store tests because persistence remains out of scope
risks: editing must not allocate a new draft ID or recreate the element
cancel and validation must not mutate the draft
edit controls must remain keyboard reachable after DOM re-render
the small label slice must not grow into a general property editor
non_changes: no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
no kind, width or column editing
expected_side_effects: after Step 1 a placed temporary component can receive a different label without changing its identity or layout
after Step 2 invalid or cancelled edits leave the temporary draft unchanged
reloading the page still clears the draft
